SILENE_TARGET_HOST.description: Target Linux host FQDN or IP that SILENE should audit (forwarded as --target, e.g. host01.example.local). The host must be reachable over SSH from the agent container.

SILENE_PROFILE.description: ANSSI BP-028 hardening profile to evaluate, forwarded as --profile. Valid values: anssi-bp-028-minimal, intermediate, enhanced, high. Default: the tool's built-in default (typically anssi-bp-028-minimal).

name: anssi_silene
title: ANSSI SILENE
description: ANSSI SILENE Linux hardening assessment importer. Wraps the SILENE CLI (`silene --target <host> --profile <profile> --ssh-user <user> --ssh-key <key> --output <tmpdir> --format json`) against a target Linux host over SSH, parses every JSON file produced under the output root and emits one Faraday host for the target with every non-compliant or errored ANSSI BP-028 recommendation attached as a vulnerability. Compliant / skipped recommendations are dropped. Severity is bucketed from the recommendation level: minimal => critical (the bare-minimum baseline is not met), intermediate => high, enhanced => medium, high => low. Errored recommendations are surfaced as info. When the level is missing or unknown, a keyword heuristic on the rule title is used as a last-resort fallback. Auth: SSH key authentication via SILENE_SSH_USER and SILENE_SSH_KEY env vars (SILENE_SSH_KEY is the absolute path to a private key file inside the container); both must be set together or both omitted.
